sql.i1_viajes_por_dia:
-- I1 Viajes válidos por día en cada mes
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    viajes_por_dia AS valor,
    viajes AS viajes_validos,
    day(last_day(periodo)) AS dias
FROM viajes_por_mes
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i2_total_mediano:
-- I2 Total cobrado en el viaje mediano, en dólares
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(median(total_amount), 2) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i3_flex_fare:
-- I3 Porcentaje de viajes Flex Fare (payment_type 0 en amarillos, nulo en verdes)
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * avg((coalesce(payment_type, 0) = 0)::INT), 1) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i4_efectivo:
-- I4 Porcentaje de viajes pagados en efectivo
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * avg((coalesce(payment_type, 0) = 2)::INT), 1) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i5_propina_tarjeta:
-- I5 Propina promedio como porcentaje de la tarifa en viajes pagados con tarjeta
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * avg(tip_amount / fare_amount), 1) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
WHERE payment_type = 1 AND fare_amount > 0
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i6_cargo_cbd:
-- I6 Porcentaje de viajes que pagan el cargo de la zona de congestión de Manhattan (CBD)
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * avg((cbd_congestion_fee > 0)::INT), 1) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i7_velocidad_manhattan:
-- I7 Velocidad mediana, en millas por hora, de los viajes que empiezan y terminan en Manhattan
SELECT
    v.periodo,
    v.taxi,
    round(median(v.trip_distance / (v.duracion_min / 60)), 2) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos AS v
JOIN zonas AS inicio ON v.PULocationID = inicio.zona_id
JOIN zonas AS fin ON v.DOLocationID = fin.zona_id
WHERE inicio.distrito = 'Manhattan' AND fin.distrito = 'Manhattan'
GROUP BY v.periodo, v.taxi
ORDER BY v.taxi DESC, v.periodo
sql.i8_aeropuertos:
-- I8 Porcentaje de viajes que empiezan o terminan en Newark (1), JFK (132) o LaGuardia (138)
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * avg((PULocationID IN (1, 132, 138) OR DOLocationID IN (1, 132, 138))::INT), 1) AS valor
FROM viajes_validos
GROUP BY periodo, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo
sql.i9_registros_excluidos:
-- I9 Porcentaje de registros que no pasan las reglas de calidad de viajes_validos
WITH registros AS (
    SELECT periodo, taxi, count(*) AS total
    FROM viajes
    GROUP BY periodo, taxi
),
validos AS (
    SELECT periodo, taxi, count(*) AS validos
    FROM viajes_validos
    GROUP BY periodo, taxi
)
SELECT
    periodo,
    taxi,
    round(100 * (1 - coalesce(validos, 0) / total), 2) AS valor
FROM registros
LEFT JOIN validos USING (periodo, taxi)
ORDER BY taxi DESC, periodo

sql_comparacion:
-- Indicadores de enero a agosto de cada año, los meses disponibles en los tres años
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        v.*,
        year(v.periodo) AS anio,
        inicio.distrito = 'Manhattan' AND fin.distrito = 'Manhattan' AS dentro_de_manhattan
    FROM viajes_validos AS v
    LEFT JOIN zonas AS inicio ON v.PULocationID = inicio.zona_id
    LEFT JOIN zonas AS fin ON v.DOLocationID = fin.zona_id
    WHERE month(v.periodo) <= 8
), dias AS (
    SELECT year(periodo) AS anio,
           sum(day(last_day(periodo))) AS dias_calendario
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT periodo FROM viajes WHERE month(periodo) <= 8)
    GROUP BY anio
)
SELECT
    anio,
    taxi,
    count(*) AS viajes_validos,
    any_value(dias_calendario) AS dias_calendario,
    round(count(*) / any_value(dias_calendario), 2) AS viajes_por_dia,
    round(avg(trip_distance), 2) AS distancia_prom,
    round(avg(duracion_min), 2) AS duracion_prom_min,
    round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS total_prom,
    round(median(total_amount), 2) AS total_mediano,
    round(100 * avg((coalesce(payment_type, 0) = 0)::INT), 1) AS pct_flex_fare,
    round(100 * avg((coalesce(payment_type, 0) = 2)::INT), 1) AS pct_efectivo,
    round(100 * avg(tip_amount / fare_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 1 AND fare_amount > 0), 1) AS propina_pct_tarifa,
    round(100 * avg((cbd_congestion_fee > 0)::INT), 1) AS pct_cargo_cbd,
    round(median(trip_distance / (duracion_min / 60)) FILTER (WHERE dentro_de_manhattan), 2) AS velocidad_manhattan,
    round(100 * avg((PULocationID IN (1, 132, 138) OR DOLocationID IN (1, 132, 138))::INT), 1) AS pct_aeropuerto
FROM base JOIN dias USING (anio)
GROUP BY anio, taxi
ORDER BY taxi DESC, anio
comparacion_ejecucion: Medias y conteos, mediana del monto y mediana de velocidad en tres consultas secuenciales por año; 1 hilo, 1 GiB
